_about: The crowd's junk: one entry per thing it throws. The model goes in source/props/<id>/ (any .glb, .gltf, .fbx, .obj, .stl or .blend); scripts/render_props.py renders it tumbling, scripts/export_assets.py packs it. name: what the overlay and the commentary call it (= JUNK in derby.py). size: how big it looks next to the others (1 = a toilet). rot: degrees (x, y, z) that lay it down the way it lies on the track after it lands. tint: multiplies its colours. grime: 0..1, dirt over it. blood: {axis: x|y|z|-x|-y|-z, after rot, with -x towards the camera and -y to the right, to: 0..1} reddens that end of it, up to that fraction of its length. liquid: a blood surface inside a mug, added before it is laid down ({level, radius, offset: [x, y]} as fractions of its height and width; offset moves it off the middle, e.g. away from a handle). lid: drops the loose pieces lying wholly above that fraction of its height (a tankard's lid). credit: the model's maker, title, link and licence (shown on the Credits card once it is exported; check it matches the file you downloaded).
